id: title:Gilbert09:mark v5 api 400 responses as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery instructions and user-facing error messages for Apple Search Ads API failures, potentially aiding user diagnostics and recovery without requiring immediate removal of the keyword_report table.
review.reason: Adds a specific recovery instruction and user-facing message for Apple Search Ads 400 errors, including a workaround for unsupported campaign types, while also handling an edge case where Apple returns an empty HTTP reason phrase. This could help users diagnose and recover from reporting failures without needing to remove the keyword_report table immediately.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to documentation and error messaging; no changes to query execution, data ingestion, or systemic reliability are demonstrated. The score is not multiplied by the number of PRs or lines. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new 400 Bad Request error entry and its corresponding test case for Apple Search Ads API, while retaining an empty-reason 400 entry.
observations.code_quote: "400 Client Error: Bad Request for url: https://api.searchads.apple.com": "Apple rejected a reporting request. Some campaign types don't support keyword reporting. If the error persists, remove the keyword_report table or check your campaign types in Apple Ads.",
